# OnlineSim.Api

> Typed async C# / .NET client for the OnlineSim API, with a built-in offline mock.

## Documentation Sets

- [OnlineSim.Api — full docs](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-dotnet-api/llms-full.txt): Complete documentation of the OnlineSim.Api .NET SDK.

## Documentation

- [Changelog](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-dotnet-api/raw/changelog.md): Release notes of OnlineSim.Api.
- [Free numbers](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-dotnet-api/raw/free.md): Public numbers and their SMS — client.Free. No API key needed.
- [Numbers](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-dotnet-api/raw/numbers.md): Order a number, read its SMS, close it — client.Numbers.
- [Rent](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-dotnet-api/raw/rent.md): Rent a number for days and receive every SMS sent to it — client.Rent.
- [Testing](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-dotnet-api/raw/testing.md): Test your integration offline with MockOnlineSim — no network, key or money.
- [User](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-dotnet-api/raw/user.md): Balance, profile, payments and the webhook URL — client.User.
- [Webhooks](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-dotnet-api/raw/webhooks.md): Receive SMS as HTTP callbacks and parse them with Webhook.Parse.
